 AI predicts what David Muir will look like in 20 years' time as he celebrates his 53rd birthday
 Broadcaster David Muir is known as the face of ABC World News Tonight - under his tenure, the show has frequently earned top ratings among evening news programs
 View 9 Images 1 of 9 David Muir is celebrating his 53rd birthday on Sunday, November 8
 Chiara Fiorillo 05:00 ET, 07 Nov 2026 David Muir is celebrating his 53rd birthday this weekend - on Sunday, November 8.
 The ABC anchor was born in Syracuse, New York, on November 8, 1973. He graduated with a Bachelor of Arts in journalism from Ithaca College in 1995, and studied at the Institute on Political Journalism at Georgetown University and the University of Salamanca in Spain.
 Muir started his television career at WTVH-TV in Syracuse, where he worked as an anchor and reporter for five years. He then moved to WCVB-TV in Boston, serving as an anchor and reporter before transitioning to national news. Muir joined ABC News in August 2003 as anchor of World News Now and World News This Morning.
 READ MORE : David Muir delivers 'stark message' from voters to Trump after 'historic' midterm losses READ MORE : David Muir says he's 'never seen midterm elections like this' on World News Tonight He later anchored World News Saturday (2007) and weekend newscasts. He was also promoted to co-anchor the ABC newsmagazine 20/20 alongside Elizabeth Vargas.
 In 2014, Muir succeeded Diane Sawyer as anchor and managing editor of ABC World News Tonight. Under his tenure, the broadcast has frequently earned top ratings among evening news programs. He is also often praised by viewers for his looks - and to mark his birthday, we have asked AI what Muir might look like in 20 years' time.
 David Muir is turning 53 this weekend
 View 9 Images 2 of 9 Popular ABC anchor David Muir is celebrating his 53rd birthday this weekend. The journalist was born in Syracuse, New York, on November 8, 1973. He graduated with a Bachelor of Arts in journalism from Ithaca College in 1995. He also studied at the Institute on Political Journalism at Georgetown University and the University of Salamanca in Spain. (Image: Getty Images for for Perelman Performing Arts Center (PAC NYC)) 
 Muir is often praised for his looks
 View 9 Images 3 of 9 Muir joined ABC News in 2003, initially anchoring World News Now and serving as a lead correspondent dispatched to global breaking news stories. He was then promoted to anchor the weekend edition of World News Tonight and served as Diane Sawyer's primary substitute anchor. In 2014, Muir succeeded Sawyer becoming the main anchor and managing editor of the program, which has consistently ranked among the most-watched US evening newscasts. The ABC broadcaster often draws social media praise and fan attention for his youthful appearance and sharp style. Fans often say they're shocked to learn that Muir is in his 50s, comparing his looks over the years. (Image: davidmuirabc/Instagram) 
 ‌ 
 AI has imagined what he might look like in 20 years
 View 9 Images 4 of 9 Since Muir has always looked youthful over the years, we have asked ChatGPT to imagine what he might look like in 20 years. A series of AI-generated images suggest that while Muir could retain many of his familiar facial characteristics, two decades of natural aging might bring some noticeable changes to his appearance. The biggest difference is the change in his hair. (Image: ChatGPT) 
 The most noticeable change is the hair
 View 9 Images 5 of 9 According to ChatGPT, one of the most striking predicted changes could be Muir's hair. Currently recognized for his dark, carefully styled hairstyle, the imagined 73-year-old version of Muir has considerably more silver and grey throughout. " His familiar swept-back hairstyle remains, although the overall appearance is more mature and distinguished," the AI chatbot told us. The AI version of Muir shows him with long, salt and pepper hair. (Image: ChatGPT) 
 ‌ 
 ChatGPT imagined Muir's distinguished appearance
 View 9 Images 6 of 9 According to the AI platform, Muir could develop more pronounced horizontal lines across his forehead - a natural consequence of the aging process. " His forehead might appear slightly more textured, with deeper creases becoming visible when he raises his eyebrows or concentrates," ChatGPT said. " There is also some softening around his lower cheeks, although his overall facial proportions remain relatively familiar." (Image: ChatGPT) 
 ChatGPT says he will show a 'more weathered and mature' personality
 View 9 Images 7 of 9 According to ChatGPT, Muir's potential future appearance will show "a more weathered, mature television personality." The chatbot told the Irish Star, " His facial contours appear softer, particularly around the cheeks and lower jaw. Not only that, but Muir's overall appearance is that of a "mature, distinguished television personality". ChatGPT also said that Muir has a "more relaxed and contemplative expression." (Image: ChatGPT)
